the light consumer (the rut-json batch phase 1): json mounts with NO
peers in the closure — the base alone (traits, reader/writer, prims,
?T, [T], entries); the peer-gated container rows never exist here and
a reference to them diagnoses (D2 — asserted in
json_pkg.rs).

THE LAW this fixture pins: dev-deps mount into the closure exactly
like deps (load_dir_session pass 2), and json's groups are
presence-gated — listing pouch/nmapset in ANY dep table of this
fixture would silently mount the full json. Light means json ALONE.
